Rules.InvariantScript:
Set(gblBusy, true);
Set(gblError, {IsVisible: false, Title: "", Detail: ""});
IfError(
    Set(gblMyWork, First(db_dq_sandbox.dquspGetMyWork({ActorUpn: gblActorUpn}).ResultSets.Table1)),
    Set(gblError, {IsVisible: true, Title: "Could not load your counts", Detail: FirstError.Message})
);
Set(gblIsAdmin, Coalesce(gblMyWork.IsAdmin, false));
Set(gblIsApprover, Coalesce(gblMyWork.IsApprover, false) || gblIsAdmin);

ClearCollect(
    colTiles,
    {
        Seq: 1,
        Count: Coalesce(gblMyWork.AssignedToMe, 0),
        Caption: "exceptions assigned to you",
        Badge: "",
        BadgeTone: "",
        Target: "QUEUE",
        CtxAssignee: gblActorUpn,
        CtxSeverity: "",
        CtxOverdue: false
    },
    {
        Seq: 2,
        Count: Coalesce(gblMyWork.OverdueForMe, 0),
        Caption: "of those are overdue",
        Badge: If(Coalesce(gblMyWork.OverdueForMe, 0) > 0, "attention", ""),
        BadgeTone: "amber",
        Target: "QUEUE",
        CtxAssignee: gblActorUpn,
        CtxSeverity: "",
        CtxOverdue: true
    },
    {
        Seq: 3,
        Count: Coalesce(gblMyWork.UnassignedCritical, 0),
        Caption: "unassigned critical exceptions in your domains",
        Badge: If(Coalesce(gblMyWork.UnassignedCritical, 0) > 0, "attention", ""),
        BadgeTone: "red",
        Target: "QUEUE",
        CtxAssignee: "UNASSIGNED",
        CtxSeverity: "CRITICAL",
        CtxOverdue: false
    },
    {
        Seq: 4,
        Count: Coalesce(gblMyWork.ClustersToConfirm, 0),
        Caption: "clusters awaiting your confirmation",
        Badge: "",
        BadgeTone: "",
        Target: "CLUSTERS",
        CtxAssignee: "",
        CtxSeverity: "",
        CtxOverdue: false
    }
);
If(
    gblIsApprover,
    Collect(
        colTiles,
        {
            Seq: 5,
            Count: Coalesce(gblMyWork.ApprovalsWaiting, 0),
            Caption: "approval" & If(Coalesce(gblMyWork.ApprovalsWaiting, 0) = 1, "", "s") & " waiting for you",
            Badge: "",
            BadgeTone: "",
            Target: "APPROVALS",
            CtxAssignee: "",
            CtxSeverity: "",
            CtxOverdue: false
        }
    )
);
Set(gblBusy, false)

Concat(Distinct(colScope, RoleCode), Result, " / ") & " · " &
 If(
     CountRows(Filter(colScope, IsBlank(DomainCode))) > 0,
     "All domains",
     Concat(gblDomains, Label, ", ")
 )

Switch(
    ThisItem.Target,
    "QUEUE",
    Navigate(
        scrQueue,
        ScreenTransition.None,
        {
            locInAssignee: ThisItem.CtxAssignee,
            locInSeverity: ThisItem.CtxSeverity,
            locInOverdue: ThisItem.CtxOverdue,
            locInCluster: Blank()
        }
    ),
    "CLUSTERS",
    Navigate(scrClusters, ScreenTransition.None),
    "APPROVALS",
    Navigate(scrApprovals, ScreenTransition.None)
)
"Looking for trends, batch health or reconciliation?"
"Those live in Power BI. This is for doing, not reading."
